datasets.name: Balance
datasets.sql:
SELECT   lastremainder.balancebill AS balanceaccount,
         firstremainder.active AS firstactive,
         firstremainder.passive AS firstpassive,
         turnovers.dturnover,
         turnovers.cturnover,
         lastremainder.active AS lastactive,
         lastremainder.passive AS lastpassive
    FROM (SELECT   b.bal_cn balancebill,
                   SUM (
                      sb_mtoutview.active (
                         ar.%sostat, /*10*/
                         b.typeid,
                         b.additionaltypeid
                      )
                   ) active,
                   SUM (
                      sb_mtoutview.passiv (
                         ar.%sostat,     /*17*/
                         b.typeid,
                         b.additionaltypeid
                      )
                   ) passive
              FROM archost ar, ACCOUNT ac, bal_spr%d b /*22*/
             WHERE (ar.acc_id = ac.id)
               AND (ac.bal_cn%d = b.bal_cn)    /*24*/
               /*25 BRANCH and CURRENCY*/
               AND (ar.datdate = :BeginPeriod)
          GROUP BY
           b.bal_cn) firstremainder,
         (SELECT   b.bal_cn balancebill,
                   SUM (ar.%sobr_d) dturnover,/*30*/
                   SUM (ar.%sobr_k) cturnover /*31*/
              FROM archost ar, ACCOUNT ac, bal_spr%d b /*32*/
             WHERE (ar.acc_id = ac.id)
               AND (ac.bal_cn%d = b.bal_cn)                 /*34*/
               /*35 BRANCH and CURRENCY*/
               AND (ar.datdate BETWEEN :BeginDate AND :EndDate)
          GROUP BY b.bal_cn) turnovers,
         (SELECT  b.bal_cn balancebill,
                   SUM (
                      sb_mtoutview.active (
                         ar.%sostat,/*41*/
                         b.typeid,
                         b.additionaltypeid
                      )
                   ) active,
                   SUM (
                      sb_mtoutview.passiv (
                         ar.%sostat,/*48*/
                         b.typeid,
                         b.additionaltypeid
                      )
                   ) passive
              FROM archost ar, ACCOUNT ac, bal_spr%d b  /*53*/
             WHERE (ar.acc_id = ac.id)
               AND (ac.bal_cn%d = b.bal_cn)  /*55*/
               /*56 BRANCH and CURRENCY*/
               AND (ar.datdate = :EndDate)
          GROUP BY
           b.bal_cn) lastremainder
   WHERE
    lastremainder.balancebill = firstremainder.balancebill(+)
     AND lastremainder.balancebill = turnovers.balancebill
ORDER BY lastremainder.balancebill

datasets.name: Account
datasets.sql:
select
  RestForLastPeriod.AccountID , RestForLastPeriod.Name ,
  RestForLastPeriod.AccNo ,
  RestForLastPeriod.CurrencyID ,
  RestForLastPeriod.BranchID ,
  RestForLastPeriod.BalanceNo ,
  RestForFirstPeriod.Active as BeginActive ,
  RestForFirstPeriod.Passive as BeginPassive ,
  TurnOvers.DTurnOver ,
  TurnOvers.CTurnOver ,
  RestForLastPeriod.Active as EndActive ,
  RestForLastPeriod.Passive as EndPassive
from

(select
  ac.ID as AccountID ,
  ac.acc_no as AccNo ,
  b.bal_cn  as BalanceNo ,

  sb_mtoutview.active (
    ar.%sostat,  /*20*/
    b.typeid,
    b.additionaltypeid
  ) as Active ,

  sb_mtoutview.passiv (
     ar.%sostat,   /*26*/
     b.typeid,
     b.additionaltypeid
  ) as Passive

from
  account ac ,
  archost ar ,
  bal_spr%d b  /*34*/
where
  ar.acc_id = ac.id and
  ac.bal_cn%d = b.bal_cn and     /*37*/
  ar.DatDate = :BeginPeriod and
  ((ac.Close_Dat is null)or(ac.Close_Dat > :BeginPeriod))
) RestForFirstPeriod ,

(select
  ac.ID as AccountID , ac.name ,
  ac.acc_no as AccNo ,
  ac.val_acc as CurrencyID ,
  ac.filial as BranchID ,
  b.bal_cn  as BalanceNo ,

  sb_mtoutview.active (
    ar.%sostat,  /*50*/
    b.typeid,
    b.additionaltypeid
  ) as Active ,

  sb_mtoutview.passiv (
     ar.%sostat,  /*56*/
     b.typeid,
     b.additionaltypeid
  ) as Passive

from
  account ac ,
  archost ar ,
  bal_spr%d b  /*64*/
where
  ar.acc_id = ac.id and
  ac.bal_cn%d = b.bal_cn and  /*67*/
  ar.DatDate = :EndDate and
  ((ac.Close_Dat is null)or(ac.Close_Dat > :EndDate))
) RestForLastPeriod ,

(select
  ac.ID as AccountID ,
  min(ac.acc_no) as AccNo,
  min(b.bal_cn)  as BalanceNo ,
  sum(ar.%sObr_D) as DTurnOver , /*76*/
  sum(ar.%sObr_K) as CTurnOver   /*77*/
from
  account ac ,
  archost ar ,
  bal_spr%d b  /*81*/
where
  ar.acc_id = ac.id and
  ac.bal_cn%d = b.bal_cn and /*84*/
  ar.DatDate between :BeginDate and :EndDate
group by
  ac.ID
) TurnOvers

where
  /* Branch & Currency*/
  RestForLastPeriod.AccountID = RestForFirstPeriod.AccountID  (+) and
  RestForLastPeriod.AccountID = TurnOvers.AccountID
  --and
  --RestForLastPeriod.BalanceNo =:BalanceNo

order by
  RestForLastPeriod.AccNo

datasets.name: Transaction
datasets.sql:
select
      t.ID,t.op_id as OperatorID, t.vid_op as OperationType,c.bal_cn1 kreditbalans,d.bal_cn1 debetbalans,
      t.dat, t.DEBT, d.acc_no as DebtAcc, dv.val_name as DValName,
      t.KREDIT, c.acc_no as CreditAcc, cv.val_name as CValName,
      t.ammount, t.ammount_c, t.lammount, t.name, SB_EXPERTANALYSE.GetUserName(t.op_id) as UserName
from
      provarch t,
      account d,
      account c,
      avalute dv,
      avalute cv
where
     t.DEBT = d.ID and
     t.KREDIT = c.ID and
     t.val_acc = dv.valute and
     t.currencyID_c = cv.valute and
     /* 16 Operator & Operation Type*/
     t.dat between :BeginDate and :EndDate

























order by
     :Title

from
      provarch t,
      account d,
      account c
   
where
     t.DEBT = d.ID and
     t.KREDIT = c.ID and     
 t.dat between  :BeginDate and :EndDate and
t.kredit= :Kredits
